name: Deploy (production stacks)

meta.description: See which stacks of the server's live Docker checkout have changes merged to main that are not running yet, and deploy one stack at the user's explicit request. A deploy fast-forwards the checkout to origin/main, runs docker compose build and up -d for that one stack, waits for its containers to be healthy, and puts the previous images back if they are not. Nothing else can be run.
